cl.x: Provide SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).

SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU is a cellular confinement system used to provide an effective measure for erosion and slope stabilisation by preventing movement of infill material with the individual cells. It is manufactured from recycled high density polyethylene (HDPE) with cell heights ranging from 75 mm to 200 mm for various surface infill depths. SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU comprises strips of perforated, expandable and flexible thermoplastic that are ultra sonically bonded to form a honeycomb matrix. Cells are secured onto slopes at intervaled anchor points according to the specification of geotechnical engineers, or may be stacked in layers to enhance structural and shear strength.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Confinement cells for slope stabilisation of landscape features both on concrete or on-grade surfaces.
